title: Create your own Gem

body.text: To create a Gem, go to the Gems menu in Gemini and click 'Create a Gem', then
name it, set its role, and add instructions for how you want it to respond
— like its answering style, knowledge scope, or language.

example: "Create a Gem named 'Marketing Assistant' that responds like a Marketing Specialist with 10 years of experience."

title: Define a Gem's behavior

body.text: You can add detailed instructions to a Gem, like
telling it to always answer briefly, use Thai, or never go off-topic
. The clearer the instructions, the more closely the Gem works the way you want.

example: "Instructions: Always answer in Thai, use bullet points, and no more than 5 points per answer."
